headline: TOP-4 AI, HALF
OPUS'S **PRICE**
cover.hook_pick_reason: Names the Opus comparison and the price effect for people who pay for AI: slide 3 shows $2 / $10 vs $4 / $20, and slide 2 shows the 4th-overall rank (confirmed by the fact-check). slides.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro climbs the charts
body: **Moonshot**, a Chinese AI startup, unveiled Kimi K3.1 Pro on Friday. It is a 3-trillion-parameter model. Its promise: the weights, the downloadable model files known as "open weights," arrive under an open license on **Nov 4, 2026**.

slides.title: 44 to 55 on an independent index
body: Artificial Analysis, an independent benchmark site, gives K3.1 Pro **55** on its Intelligence Index. The earlier K3 scored 44. That ranks Kimi **4th overall**.

slides.title: Half the cost of Claude Opus 5.5
body: Kimi's API costs **$2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens**. Claude Opus 5.5 charges $4 and $20. In Artificial Analysis's Terminal-Bench 4.0 run, Kimi rose from 13% to 67%, past Sonnet 5.5's 64%.

slides.title: Opus still leads on some tests
body: Moonshot's own comparison has Kimi just behind Opus on Terminal-Bench 4.0 (**65.7 vs 66.4**). On Terminal-Bench Science 0.1 the gap is wide: **38.1** vs 63.3 for Opus and 68.1 for GPT-6 Astra.

slides.title: Open weights are still a promise
body: Nothing is downloadable yet. The release is due **Nov 4**. And Kimi is not the cheapest: at peak rates, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash costs about **one-seventh** of Kimi's input price and one-eighth of its output price.

facts.text: Moonshot, a Chinese AI startup, unveiled Kimi K3.1 Pro on Friday. The model has 3 trillion parameters, and its weights are due under an open license on Nov 4, 2026.
Kimi K3.1 Pro scores 55 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (K3 scored 44) and ranks 4th overall. Artificial Analysis is an independent benchmark site.
API pricing is $2 / $10 per million tokens (input / output), versus $4 / $20 for Claude Opus 5.5.
In Artificial Analysis's evaluation, Kimi's Terminal-Bench 4.0 score rose from 13% to 67%, compared with 64% for Sonnet 5.5.
In Moonshot's own comparison, Kimi is narrowly behind Opus on Terminal-Bench 4.0 (65.7 vs 66.4) and far behind on Terminal-Bench Science 0.1 (38.1 vs 63.3 for Opus and 68.1 for GPT-6 Astra).
At peak rates, Kimi charges about 6.7 times as much for uncached input and 8.3 times as much for output as DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (about one-seventh and one-eighth of Kimi's prices).

sources.title: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro flirts with open weights leadership amid paid influencer scandal allegations

caption:
Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro, a top-4 model on an independent AI index, costs half as much as Claude Opus 5.5.

Moonshot, a Chinese AI startup, says the model's weights (downloadable model files) will be released openly on Nov 4. That is a promise, not a release yet.

→ Artificial Analysis, an independent benchmark site, scores Kimi K3.1 Pro 55 (up from 44), ranking it 4th overall
→ API price: $2 / $10 per million tokens vs $4 / $20 for Claude Opus 5.5
→ Moonshot's own tests show Kimi still behind Opus on some benchmarks

Would you switch to an open-weights model if it costs half as much as Opus?

Source: VentureBeat, "Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro flirts with open weights leadership amid paid influencer scandal allegations", Oct 25, 2026.
